description: This file defines a mock class 'ServiceMock' for unit testing, which implements two interfaces: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell and WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell::ICOMLink. It includes mock methods for various functionalities related to a service plugin in the WPEFramework component, and uses Google Mock framework for mocking.
